full_judgment: 2. The petitioner after completion of his Masters in Economics from Dhaka University in 1968 joined the said College on 21.7.1969 as a lecturer of Economics and thereafter he was promoted as the Principal of the said College on 26.5.1970. The college was thereafter promoted a Degree College. Subsequently in 1975 Damodya was developed to a Thana. The petitioner being a Principal of the said College was also working as an Examiner of Economics for the HSC Examination since 1972 and for the Degree Examination since 1973 and he also worked as a Head Examiner of Economics (Second Paper) for the H.S.C. Examination on 1986 and 1987. In 1987 the petitioner was selected the Best Teacher of the Shariotpur, District. Thereafter on the basis of a complaint, the Respondent No.1 illegally formed a one member investigation committee consisting of one Additional District Magistrate, Shariotpur, without calling any meeting of the College Governing Body, to investigate into the said matter though under clause 16(a) of বেসরকারী ডিগ্রী কলেজ শিক্ষক চাকুরী শর্ত বিধি ৯৪ it is clearly stated that any such committee should consist of 5 members and clause ১৩(২)ছ of the অধিভুক্ত ডিগ্রী কলেজ সমূহের গভার���নিৎ বডি; জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় সংবিধি ১৯৯8 states that কলেজের গভার্নিৎ বডির ক্ষমতা প্রযোজ্য মোতাবেক কমিটি পঠন করবে; তবে শর্ত থাকে যে; এরূপ গঠিত কমিটির সুপারিশমালা বাস্তবায়নের পূর্বে গভার্নিত্ বডি তা পযালোচনা করবে এবং ঐ সুপারিশমালা গ্রহণ; সংশোধন বা বাতিল করতে পারবে৷
